answer: Use a delayed hardware-attestation queue: each agent identity needs a sealed boot measurement signed by a device-bound falcon key, with one identity per device per 30 days. It must answer a local challenge derived from karst terrain radio fingerprints, so one operator cannot mass-produce valid submissions without moving distinct hardware. A rotating cipher validates it, and a forged identity costs a full 30-day quarantine plus fresh on-site fingerprint capture.
